values.headline: Thunderbelles' 5th-set grit turns back Crossovers
values.subheadline: CANDON, Ilocos Sur—Given the opportunity to rise, ZUS Coffee seized the moment in a grueling, high-stakes battle-the Thunderbelles seemed tailor-made for delivering a poised yet fear-less performance to shock a stunned Chery Tiggo, 19-25, 22-25, 18-25, 25-19, 15-6 in the PVL On Tour Tuesday at the Candon City Arena.

values.headline: Tenorio to follow in Jawo's footsteps as playing coach?
Caloocan, Pangasinan hurdle rivals
values.subheadline: CALOOCAN and Pangasinan notched contrasting wins on Monday to rev up their drive in Manny Pacquiao Pres-ents MPBL 2025 Season at the Batangas City Coliseum.

values.headline: Cone lauds CJ Perez for helping Gilas defeat Black Bears
values.subheadline: AFTER Gilas Pilipinas scored a come-from-behind, 103-98 win over the visiting Macau Black Bears on Monday night, coach Tim Cone took note of how players like CJ Perez can contribute to the team's cause.

values.headline: Edoc shines as weather whips up surprises at JPGT Riviera
values.subheadline: SILANG, Cavite - Zoji Edoc lived up to the hype as star status, overcoming a composed and steady frontside breeze a six-stroke lead in the ICTSI Riviera Golf Junior PGT Riviera Golf Club, Inc.
